votes.motion: Approve work session minutes of June 1, 2021; June 15, 2021; and July 13, 2021 as well as the formal meeting minutes of October 4, 2022 and December 13, 2022.
votes.description: The Council approved multiple prior meeting minutes from both work sessions and formal meetings spanning 2021 and 2022.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 01 of 2023 an extension of Declaration of Local Emergency: Winter Overflow Shelter Overnight Occupancy Caps.
votes.description: The Council extended the Mayor's December 20, 2022 proclamation declaring a local emergency relating to shelter bed caps for winter overflow shelter overnight occupancy.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 02 of 2023 approving a $100,000 loan for Forty Three Bakery/Streusel, LLC, from Economic Development Loan Fund.
votes.description: The Council approved a $100,000 EDLF loan to Forty Three Bakery/Streusel LLC at 713 Genesee Avenue to assist in creating 20 new jobs and retaining 7 current jobs.

The Council approved the full consent agenda, which included setting public hearing dates for several zoning and ordinance items and approving five board appointments to the Accessibility and Disability Commission and Racial Equity in Policing Commission.
